Subject: [opensuse] java-1_6_0-sun-src package is missing in the main repository

There is no jdk source code package available for jdk 1.6 in the main
repository, which is highly needed during development.

There is java-1_5_0-sun-src source package for java 1.5, but no 1.6 analog.

Also there is no javadoc packages neither for 1.5, no for 1.6 javas. But for
jdk 1.5 this is ok - both eclipse and netbeans can generate
javadoc from jdk sources on a fly; but for jdk 1.6 I even can't see javadoc
comments for jdk standard classes during code autocompletion for example
(this could be still solved just by adding jdk1.6 source code package, so
probably separate javadoc packages are not needed).
